reviews.text: Excellent service very clean and staff very polite and friendly receptionist extremely helpful 10/10 Thank you.x
Poor communication on treatment day, very disappointed. Polite but not transparent, which is just as important.

Richmond Vets4Pets is a fantastic veterinary practice. The doctors we have dealt with are knowledgeable and very professional. The entire staff are obviously people who care about animals and their families.

I called to let them know my bulldog Albert died so they could update their files. A week later I received a lovely, handwritten sympathy card. We will always remember their thoughtfulness and kindness.

Honestly I am disgusted and disappointed with how this vets 4 pets employees act. They are so desperate for money and not for the cats health it’s so pathetic. I don’t understand how vets which need so many qualifications can act like this and put the animals health at risk just to get money out of it. This whole place is unprofessional and they need a serious think about their actions.They book appointments do nothing at the appointment other than talk about irrelevant stuff and take ridiculous amounts of money after not doing anything at the appointment. I am honestly so disappointed and want to warn people from this place.

I would highly recommend Vets4Pets my dog was really unwell and they were very empathetic and reassuring. Chris was super thorough and called me a number of times to keep me updated after an X-Ray and then surgery. I also saw Marcus and Dan for follow up appointments and didn’t feel at all rushed at any point or I was asking too many questions. Dan also followed up with new food recommendations that he has researched for another patient! The nurse Sonin (apologies I misspelt) called me to follow up a week after surgery and was so lovely and helpful and again giving lots of advice outside of the surgery aftercare check up. I don’t often go out of my way to leave reviews but I am so so happy with the service my little dog received and I will continue to use them for anything else. :)
A lovely nice and clean place for pets to take care of them. Very good location and they cover so many services for your pets.

Avoid at all costs! After having to wait 3 days to find out the test results for my elderly dog that was peeing blood and in pain! They didn’t even offer anything for the pain over the 3 day wait, we had to call another vet for a second opinion and then called vets for pets who said oh we will “sort something out”- They do not care for animals lives or wellbeing.

Disgusting how they have taken advantage of a vulnerable situation.

All they care about is Money.
That’s all I have to say!

Booked an appointment for a certain time. Was there on time (even before the appointment time) but rather than respect the time they took in someone who had an appointment after us. We ended up waiting for over 25mins. Not something I appreciate when booking for a certain time and being on time especially as it’s distressing for the animal to sit there and wait.

Vet4pets Richmond today were absolutely amazing. Had to bring my poorly cat in with my autistic son, they were kind, compassionate and completely professional. My darling cat had to be pts and they were so amazing through the process and my son left without being distressed or traumatised. Can’t sing their praises enough for going above and beyond for my family.

A very good vet practice and I have been going there for years and always feel welcome when I need to go there and the staff are very understanding and lovely towards my almost year old GermanShepherd. Highly recommend

SHOCKING! DON'T BUY ANY PRODUCTS THERE. After the visit the nurse recommended to buy  ProDen PlaqueOff Powder for Dogs & Cats, I bought the product 60mg in the clinic for £26.84. Back home I  was doubting the high price for a plaque remover in such a small bottle. They are selling the procuct for 60% more! I  immediately called the vet asking to bring the unopened prodcut back for a refund. They refused with the reason that i was told by the nurse that i can either buy it online or in the clinic!

I’ve been bringing my two dogs to Vets4Pets Richmond for over three years now, and I honestly cannot fault them. Chris and his team are fantastic – they genuinely care about the wellbeing of the animals they treat. One of my dogs has a long-term health condition, and I trust Chris and the other vets 100% with his care.

We previously had a bad experience with another vet who seemed more focused on money than our dog’s health. That made us realise how important it is to find a vet who truly cares – and Chris and the team at Richmond are exactly that. They’re not in it for the money; they’re in it for the animals.

The receptionists are also always so helpful and friendly – they really complete the experience and make every visit that much easier. I’m so grateful we found them.

Heartbreaking Loss Due to Misdiagnosis and Overmedication — Please Be Cautious

I am deeply devastated by the care my beloved cat, Milo, received at this clinic under the supervision of vet Alexandra Chester. What began as an emergency visit for a brief body tremor (lasting only a few seconds) turned into an avoidable tragedy — due to what I believe was a misdiagnosis, overmedication with Meloxicam, and repeatedly dismissed concerns.

I brought him in purely as a precaution, to rule out anything serious — especially since he was otherwise acting completely normal, healthy, and playful.

Milo was completely healthy before this: eating, drinking, playing, and never having suffered from any illness. But his condition began to decline rapidly after being given Meloxicam over four consecutive days — a powerful anti-inflammatory drug that requires close monitoring.

His initial blood tests were entirely normal. But after repeated doses of Meloxicam, abnormal results began to appear — yet no meaningful adjustments were made to his treatment, even as his condition clearly worsened.

I raised my concerns multiple times and specifically requested further diagnostics like ultrasounds and scans. Instead, I was repeatedly reassured with comments like, “I’m not super worried about him. He’s not very ill. He is just in pain and we need to manage the pain with painkillers. No need for further tests.”
I felt ignored and dismissed — as though his obvious decline wasn’t being taken seriously, and as if his life didn’t truly matter to them.

Because of this negligence, I spent over £9,000 trying to save him — costs I never would have faced had Milo received appropriate care from the start. £1,895 was spent at this clinic, and £7,550 at the emergency hospital where he was finally referred once his condition became critical.
But by then, the damage to his kidneys and stomach was extensive and irreversible.

Milo spent his final days in pain and alone — and it breaks my heart knowing he was isolated in a hospital, without the comfort of familiar hands or the love he was used to.

He underwent emergency surgery and spent two days in the ICU receiving intensive care. But it was too late. He didn’t recover.
The emergency team ultimately made the decision to euthanize him — a moment I wasn’t prepared for, and one that will stay with me forever.

What I truly lost is irreplaceable.

I genuinely believe this could have been prevented had Milo received more attentive, cautious, and competent care from the beginning.

Please think twice before trusting this clinic with your cat’s life.

I’ve included two photos below:
Photo 1 – Milo before treatment: taken the first day he was seen at the clinic — happy, healthy, and full of life.
Photo 2 – Milo after his condition declined under the care of Alexandra Chester, just before being referred to the emergency hospital. At that point, she said:
“I tried to figure out what was wrong, but I couldn’t. It’s better to refer him to a specialist.”
By then, it was already too late.

It breaks my heart to share this, but I do so in the hope that others won’t have to endure the same pain caused by such poor veterinary judgment.
